snp3.6:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
snp3.6:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sabhiyassa paribbājakassa purāṇasālohitāya devatāya pañhā udiṭṭhā honti
snp3.6:1.4: yo te sabhiya samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ime pañhe puṭṭho byākaroti tassa santike brahmacariyaṃ careyyāsīti.
snp3.6:2.1: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako tassā devatāya santike pañhe uggahetvā ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa seyyathīdaṃ
snp3.6:2.2: pūraṇo kassapo makkhali gosālo ajito kesakambalo pakuddho kaccāyano sañjayo veḷaṭṭhaputto nigantho nāṭaputto
snp3.6:2.4: te sabhiyena paribbājakena pañhe puṭṭhā na sampāyanti
snp3.6:3.2: ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa seyyathīdaṃ
snp3.6:3.4: te mayā pañhe puṭṭhā na sampāyanti
snp3.6:3.5: asampāyantā kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātu karonti
snp3.6:4.2: ayaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa.
snp3.6:4.3: yannūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ime pañhe puccheyyanti.
snp3.6:5.2: ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā jiṇṇā vuḍḍhā mahallakā addhagatā vayo anuppattā therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa seyyathīdaṃ
snp3.6:5.4: tepi mayā pañhe puṭṭhā na sampāyanti
snp3.6:5.5: asampāyantā kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaronti api ca maññevettha paṭipucchanti.
snp3.6:5.6: kiṃ pana me samaṇo gotamo ime pañhe puṭṭho byākarissati.
snp3.6:5.7: samaṇo hi gotamo daharo ceva jātiyā navo ca pabbajjāyāti.
snp3.6:6.2: samaṇo kho gotamo daharoti na uññātabbo na paribhotabbo
snp3.6:6.3: daharopi ce samaṇo hoti so ca mahiddhiko hoti mahānubhāvo. yannūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ime pañhe puccheyyanti.
snp3.6:7.1: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako yena rājagahaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi
snp3.6:7.2: anupubbena cārikañcaramāno yena rājagahaṃ veḷuvanaṃ kalandakanivāpo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
snp3.6:7.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
snp3.6:7.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sabhiyo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
snp3.6:11.2: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhūtaṃ vata bho
snp3.6:11.3: yaṃ vatāhaṃ aññesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu okāsakammamattampi nālatthaṃ tamme idaṃ samaṇena gotamena okāsakammaṃ katanti
snp3.6:11.4: attamano pamudito udaggo pītisoma nassajāto bhagavantaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi

snp3.6:23.1: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako …pe… bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi

snp3.6:41.1: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā attamano udaggo pamudito pītisomanassajāto uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi
snp3.6:42.1: yāni ca tīṇi yāni ca saṭṭhi
snp3.6:52.1: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
snp3.6:52.2: abhikkantaṃ bhante abhikkantaṃ bhante seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evamevaṃ bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
snp3.6:52.3: esāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
snp3.6:52.4: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
snp3.6:53.1: yo kho sabhiya aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ so cattāro māse parivasati catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena parivuṭṭhaparivāsaṃ āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya
snp3.6:54.1: sace bhante aññatitthiyapubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ ā kaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ cattāro māse parivasanti catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena parivuṭṭhaparivāse āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya. ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasāmi catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena parivuṭṭhaparivāsaṃ āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājentu upasampādentu bhikkhubhāvāyāti.
snp3.6:54.2: alattha kho sabhiyo paribbājako bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ. acirupasampanno kho panāyasmā sabhiyo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
snp3.6:54.3: aññataro kho panāyasmā sabhiyo arahataṃ ahosīti.
snp3.6:54.4: sabhiyasuttaṃ chaṭṭhamaṃ. suttanipāte tatiyassa mahāvaggassa sattamaṃ selasuttaṃ 7 evamme
